note: Cases a conforming implementation must distinguish. Each states the input and the only conforming outcome.

cases.input: an interval no Filing Party observed, every party whose Filing Plan required the observation having declared the gap under C1 through C4
cases.expect: Unresolved: excluded from numerator and denominator; counted in the Unresolved Fraction; no fault recorded
cases.must_not: counted as delivered, or as not delivered, or attributed to a party

cases.input: an interval a party's own Filing Plan required it to observe, and it neither observed nor declared under C1 through C4
cases.expect: attributed to that party under C3; J1 applies; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, read under 2.5.2 where no party observed
cases.must_not: treated as Unresolved with no fault recorded

cases.input: a measurement whose expanded uncertainty exceeds the procedure's bound
cases.expect: no reading; a BoundaryRecord with cause instrument-failure
cases.must_not: a low reading, or evidence the field was below its floor

cases.input: the review deadline passes with no Counterparty Decision filed
cases.expect: terminal state expired, from the closing of the review window or the timeout at the Case deadline
cases.must_not: terminal state accepted, or expired derived from any other event

cases.input: L3 conforming and L7 non-conforming in one interval, both covered
cases.must_not: delivered on the strength of the conforming layer

cases.input: a Profile naming L8 among the covered Layers
cases.must_not: armed with L8 counting against the provider

cases.input: J1 selecting EF-02 where the required evidence class is operator-held
cases.expect: the selection is refused at arming time

cases.input: a Grade Class carrying a V4 field with no required evidence class
a Grade Class field left blank
cases.expect: the Grade Class is incomplete and cannot be armed

cases.input: an MP-06 identity reading whose baseline was committed after the Window opened
a material Divergence under a Profile selecting DR-02, with the two figures inside the bound
cases.expect: the arithmetic mean governs the quantity; the terminal state still comes from F2
cases.must_not: a terminal state derived from the resolution

cases.input: a record armed under version 1.0, read after a later version issues
no Filing Party observed; one required party declared the gap under C1 through C4, the other did not
cases.expect: the undeclared party bears the fault under J1; the declaring party bears none; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, under EF-04 or EF-05 excluded and counted in the Unresolved Fraction
cases.must_not: a fault recorded against the party that declared, or the interval read as Unresolved with no fault

cases.input: no Filing Party observed, both required to observe, neither declared
cases.expect: each party bears its own fault under J1; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, read under 2.5.2
cases.must_not: one fault shared between the parties, or no fault recorded
